ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are two NAND gates arranged one above the other. The upper NAND gate has external input A on the left, and the output on the right is labeled Q; the lower NAND gate has external input B on the left, and the output on the right is labeled Q̅. The two gates are cross-feedback: the upper output Q is fed back to one input of the lower NAND, and the lower output Q̅ is fed back to one input of the upper NAND, forming a cross-coupled NAND structure. Reasoning: The propagation delay of each NAND gate is 1 ns. From external input A to the upper output Q, it only passes through the upper NAND, which is 1 gate delay; if it continues to affect the lower output Q̅ through feedback, then it passes through the lower NAND again, for a total of 2 NAND delays. Similarly, from input B to the lower output Q̅ is 1 gate delay, while for B to affect the upper output Q it must pass through the lower NAND and then through the upper NAND, for a total of 2 NAND delays. It can be seen that the longest visible cascaded path from external input to output contains 2 NAND gates. Therefore the critical path delay = 2 × 1 ns = 2 ns.

method.method_draft: First describe the image topology: a cross-coupled pair of NAND gates, upper output Q fed back to the lower NAND input and lower output Q̅ fed back to the upper NAND input. From an external input such as A, a transition can affect Q after passing through the upper NAND once, and then can propagate through the feedback into the lower NAND to affect Q̅, totaling two NAND delays. Similarly, B to Q goes through the lower NAND then the upper NAND. No external-input-to-output path contains more than these two cascaded NAND gates in the visible circuit, so multiply 2 gates by 1 ns/gate to get 2 ns.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中有两个 NAND 门上下排列。上方 NAND 门左侧有外部输入 A，右侧输出标为 Q；下方 NAND 门左侧有外部输入 B，右侧输出标为 Q̅。两个门交叉反馈：上方输出 Q 反馈到下方 NAND 的一个输入，下方输出 Q̅ 反馈到上方 NAND 的一个输入，形成交叉耦合 NAND 结构。推理：每个 NAND 门传播延迟为 1 ns。从外部输入 A 到上方输出 Q，只经过上方 NAND，为 1 个门延迟；若继续通过反馈影响下方输出 Q̅，则再经过下方 NAND，总共 2 个 NAND 延迟。同理，从输入 B 到下方输出 Q̅ 是 1 个门延迟，而从 B 影响上方输出 Q 要经过下方 NAND 再经过上方 NAND，总共 2 个 NAND 延迟。可见外部输入到输出的最长可见级联路径包含 2 个 NAND 门。因此临界路径延迟 = 2 × 1 ns = 2 ns。

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use static timing analysis for combinational paths through gates in a feedback latch: the propagation delay along a path is the sum of gate delays, and the critical path is the maximum number of sequential gates a change must traverse from an external input to an observed output.
